input: Source a reliable international shipping service for gifts

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which countries are involved determines which carriers are eligible, since not all services operate in every corridor or handle customs the same way.
Shipping costs vary enormously by carrier and speed; a tight budget rules out premium express services and shapes the shortlist immediately.
The size, weight, and fragility of the gifts directly affect which carriers can be used and what packaging or insurance is required.
A hard delivery deadline (e.g., a birthday or holiday) determines whether economy or express options are viable.
Whether this is a one-off personal shipment or ongoing gifting (e.g., for a business) changes whether a contract account or a pay-as-you-go service is more appropriate.
Some senders prioritise tracking visibility, others care most about reliability, insurance coverage, or carrier reputation — this shapes which service attributes to rank highest.
Defining what a successful outcome looks like — a signed contract, a completed first shipment, or simply a shortlist of options — determines how far the research and action plan needs to go.

gold.taskTitle: Source reliable international shipping for gifts
gold.taskDescription: Find and select a trustworthy international shipping service suitable for sending gifts abroad.

questions.title: Which countries are you shipping gifts to?
questions.description: Identify the destination countries so eligible carriers and customs requirements can be scoped correctly.

questions.title: What is your budget per shipment?
questions.description: Establish a per-shipment cost ceiling to filter out premium services that exceed it.

questions.title: How large or heavy are the gift packages?
questions.description: Determine approximate dimensions and weight, and whether items are fragile, to match carrier capabilities.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which gifts must arrive?
questions.description: Identify any hard delivery date to decide whether economy, standard, or express transit speeds are needed.

questions.title: Is this a one-time send or a recurring need?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a single personal shipment or an ongoing requirement, to judge whether a contract account adds value.

questions.title: What matters most: tracking, speed, or insurance coverage?
questions.description: Rank the user's top service priorities so the evaluation criteria can be weighted accordingly.

questions.title: What does a successful outcome look like to you?
questions.description: Determine whether the goal is a shortlist of options, a chosen carrier, or a completed first shipment, to set the right endpoint for the plan.
